title: When no recorded day exists on or before the end of the selected range, the report shows the no-data message and no totals row
permissions_required: A role with the existing inventory-reports permission (Story 1 prerequisite).
preconditions: 1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. The date nightly recording began is known, and a past range exists that ends entirely BEFORE it (or whose only covered dates have been pruned by retention).
steps: 1. Select a Custom range ending before nightly recording began.
2. Read the data area and the bottom of the report.
expected: 1. The report shows the no-data message "Empty bays, endless possibilities. Get Going!" instead of rows.
design_ref: none — design not yet available (spec-only authoring)
